cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got Saturday sorted: we'll paint Dad's kitchen together. I'll bring everything. We need a day that isn't another trip to empty his house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't paint over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The marks stay. I'll do the walls; you can decide how much we leave around them. Come for lunch first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then that's where we'll have lunch. I'll leave the paint in the car. Saturday is still our day; the kitchen can wait until we're both ready.

reason: Replace detached authority prefixes with a confident project plan whose labor, preserved marks and eventual cancellation depend on keeping the sibling present.
